subject: A one-page experiment that someone else can take over
text:
Hi Matt,

I saw Widthipedia on VOLE — showing a different Wikipedia page at each browser width is a fun way to turn a familiar page into something unexpected.

I built Take The Wall: one public page with one featured owner. Your project replaces the current content and stays until somebody else takes over.

Would you be interested in trying it with VOLE.wtf? Browsing and previewing are free; publishing a takeover costs $3.99. It’s an early experiment, with no guaranteed audience or duration.

Here’s the page: https://takethewall.com/?utm_source=personal&utm_medium=outreach&utm_campaign=first_owners&utm_content=matt-round

No need to reply if it’s not your thing — I won’t send a follow-up sequence.

Take The Wall
contact@takethewall.com
